content: The SSO integration with Azure AD was smooth and worked on the first try!
Feedback table filters reset every time I switch pages. Really frustrating workflow.
Mobile responsive dashboard looks fantastic on iPad Pro. Very easy to read in meetings.
Our accounting team couldn't find the VAT breakdown on monthly automated billing receipts.
Exporting CSV reports takes less than 2 seconds now. Huge improvement over last version!
Wish there was a dark theme option for the Voice of Customer report viewer page.
